lines.trans: Well now, where is my tank?
Everything is fine with your tank.
Let's play another game instead!
Let's play war!
Look: hands up, surrender!
And where is my tank after all?
Do you know how to play chess? I'll teach you!
This is a knight, and this is a queen.
Please give me back my tank.
I glued it, it's drying right now.
I'm going to call mum!
What, are you a tattletale?
Well alright, your tank is here.
It is lying under the pillow.
Uncle Arkady stepped on it by accident.
